title: plan_audit.py documents end-to-end --target 22.7; its parser refuses it
claim: tools/audit/seat/plan_audit.py's usage line 'plan_audit.py end-to-end --fork SHA [--head REF] [--target 22.7]' fed to plan_audit.main's own argparse parser exits 2 'unrecognized arguments: --target 22.7': the end-to-end subparser defines only --fork and --head and the target is the constant TARGET_DS.
mechanism: The option was documented (or removed) without the other side following; a reader who passes it gets an argparse error, not a different target. Fails D5-criteria C1.

evidence.contention_note: shared box during fan-out; count is contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb plan_audit: plan_audit.main's end-to-end subparser given a --target option (argparse add_parser patched in memory)

metric_definition: 1 when plan_audit.main(argv from the docstring's end-to-end usage line) exits 2 (argparse refusal), run_end_to_end stubbed so only parsing is measured.
phenomenon_property: Every repository path, script name, usage-line option and stated item count a comment unit or docstring in the seat's cells names resolves at the ref and agrees with what the code it sits on delivers (D5-criteria C1, C2)
seam_rule: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D5/s6/m4_ledger.py --repo <git checkout holding the baseline> --ref 92d38ecb640bd462f2e19c0814d0f0b7df1ee692  # FLAGS.tsv rows of kind C1-* and C2-*
proposed_fix_scope: Docstring line drops [--target 22.7] (or the subparser gains it and main reads it instead of TARGET_DS: then it is a behaviour change).
